notes.title: THE VOID IS HERE
notes.content: [h1]THE VOID HAS COME[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/158fba0b868e16807a7f17470a0e46bb62dcfcaf.png"][/img][/p][p]A new secret level has appeared on Cursedland, will you be able to survive?[/p][p][/p][h1]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/9a782e78577aeb7a0001399d6710243ba80ff7ba.png"][/img][/p][p]You can unlock new achievemets for the new zones, and you have the Cursed-abecedary (you have to enter the Farlopa-castle to unllock it).[/p][p][/p][h1]LEVEL SELECTOR[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489705/4b66cc9fd1e2ab6f9f643aad477d9af9e8df42e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can now select a level to go to, in the Main Menu screen.[/p][p][/p][h1]THE MOON[/h1][p][/p][p]The moon level has been updated, now it is shorter than before.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: A new secret level has appeared on Cursedland, will you be able to survive?
You can unlock new achievemets for the new zones, and you have the Cursed-abecedary (you have to enter the Farlopa-castle to unllock it).
You can now select a level to go to, in the Main Menu screen.

tags.balance_change: The moon level has been updated, now it is shorter than before.
